entries.name: web-browse-capture
entries.description: Use OpenClaw browser profiles to browse, click, paginate, expand, and extract data from real webpages through a live browser. Trigger when a task needs true browser interaction rather than plain search or static fetch, such as JS-rendered pages, login-gated views, button clicks, pagination, dropdowns, tab switching, dynamic tables, or step-by-step website operations. Also trigger when the user wants to visit a specific website and collect/extract images, text, or data from it. Typical requests include: 去某个网站抓数据, 从网页抓图片, 去Pinterest抓图, 爬取网页内容, 点进这个网站抓数据, 翻页把列表都扒下来, 进后台网页操作并提取字段, 动态网页读取, 真实浏览器访问网页, browser-use 网页采集, 用浏览器进去看, 帮我去XX上抓/爬/采集, or 打开网页提取信息.
